condo: Rare Patio Loft Near Boon Keng | High Ceiling | Renovated

history.summary: A 999-year 3BR patio loft (1,410 sqft) near Boon Keng in D12, asking $1.89M ($1,340 psf) under a marketing title with no disclosed project or built_year. The quasi-freehold tenure and moderate PSF are positives, but a niche loft layout, 1.22km MRT distance and missing data temper it.
history.rating_rationale: 999-yr tenure and $1,340 psf are reasonable, and the 1,410 sqft loft offers space, but the listing hides the project name and built_year, the unit is a niche 'patio loft' (high-ceiling/loft layouts have a narrower buyer pool), and it is 15 min / 1.22km from Boon Keng MRT. No URA data to verify pricing or trajectory. Fairly priced curiosity, not a clear investment edge.
red_flags: Marketing title hides project name and built_year
Niche loft layout — narrower resale buyer pool
No URA transaction data — no price/appreciation signal
catalysts: Moderate $1,340 psf leaves some value headroom if loft appeals
